title: Actual scalar-extension functor on raw integral rationalizations
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations; regard $E_T$ as an $A_T$-algebra through the canonical isomorphism $A_T\cong(V\mapsto C(|V|,A))$ of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] followed by postcomposition with the inclusion $A\subset E$. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ be the archived module-object category of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], identified with sectionwise modules by [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding]. The actual scalar extension $F_T=E_T\otimes^L_{A_T}-$ on ambient module derived categories is exact and left adjoint to exact restriction of scalars. It carries $\mathcal I_T$ into $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ and induces an exact $E$-linear functor $J_T:\mathcal R_T\to\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ with $J_TK=F_TK$ and $J_T(u/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_T(u)$. The ambient scalar-extension unit is the derived image of $m\mapsto1\otimes m$. No full faithfulness or essential surjectivity is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-scalar-derived-encoding] with the specified coefficient inclusion and encodings. It identifies the actual internal and sectionwise derived scalar functors, proves their exactness on the ambient categories, and supplies the adjunction to exact restriction. Its unit formula on every representing complex is exactly the asserted derived image of $m\mapsto1\otimes m$.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-integral-scalar-constructible-image]. The explicit noetherian, finite-dimensional and invertibility hypotheses on $T$ are exactly its hypotheses. Thus the same actual $F_T$ carries every integral object into $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$, and this target has the induced full triangulated structure. Use the specified encoding to regard this restriction as a functor into the archived category. In the Lean interface the inherited target triangulation is supplied explicitly by realizationScalarTargetTriangulated: apply the continuous-field local-freeness theorem in the scheme universe, the constructible Serre argument, and bounded homology triangulated closure. This avoids the upstream finiteness-coefficient instance, whose continuous-field constructor is restricted to Type 0.

source.place: 6.8.11(3), 6.8.14(2); returned step 4 and end of step 6

proof.text: By step 2 and the specified encoding, $F_T$ restricts to an additive functor $F:\mathcal I_T\to\mathcal D:=\mathcal C_T^c(E)$, and $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ has the raw Hom modules $\Hom(K,L)\otimes_AE$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] and [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]. $F$ is semilinear for the inclusion $\phi:A\to E$: $1\otimes(au)=a(1\otimes u)$ by balancing, on representing complexes and hence in the derived categories. Apply [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization] with $R=A$, $t=\varpi$, $S=E$, $u=\varpi$. Since $\varpi$ is a unit of $E$, $E\to E[1/\varpi]$ is an isomorphism, so the localization functor $Q_E:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D[1/\varpi]$, identity on objects and $f\mapsto f\otimes1$, is an isomorphism of $E$-linear categories. Put $J_T=Q_E^{-1}\circ\overline F$. The cited formula $\overline F(u/\varpi^n)=\phi(\varpi)^{-n}Q_E(F(u))$ gives $J_TK=F_TK$ and $J_T(u/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_T(u)$, and the cited semilinearity for the induced map $A[1/\varpi]=E\to E[1/\varpi]$ becomes $E$-linearity of $J_T$.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), the functor on the raw scalar localization

proof.text: $\mathcal I_T$ is closed under shifts and cones in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization], with $A$-linear shift; $\mathcal D$ is a full triangulated subcategory with $E$-linear shift by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-scalar-constructible-image]. By [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-scalar-derived-encoding] the ambient $F_T$ is triangulated with its termwise shift comparison, so $F$ is exact with a semilinear shift comparison. Give $\mathcal R_T$ and $\mathcal D[1/\varpi]$ the triangulations of [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated]. The exactness clause of [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization] makes $\overline F$ exact with the localized shift comparison. A triangle of $\mathcal D[1/\varpi]$ is distinguished exactly when it is isomorphic to the $Q_E$-image of a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal D$, and $Q_E$ is an isomorphism commuting with shifts; hence $Q_E^{-1}$ is exact, and so is $J_T$.
